notes: Sage demo employee "janneman" (a Sage demo record, not a real person). Sage tax status: statutory. Sage shows age 41 only; the date of birth is set to 1 January 1985 to give that age. No case is near 65 (rebates) or 18-29 (ETI). Net is not on the Sage table: it is monthly pay less the Sage PAYE and employee UIF (no other deductions). ETI: nil by ETI Act s6(a), age outside 18-29.
